note: Empty on purpose -- the current SS3 cohort hasn't graduated through the roster infrastructure yet. A class only belongs here once tendercare-teacher's run_promotion() (0012_run_promotion.sql) has actually marked them graduated on September 1st, not before. Each class's id_recycle_eligible_on is exactly one year after graduated_on. A matching recycling job reclaims that class's IDs into the incoming JSS1 class once id_recycle_eligible_on has passed, so dormant alumni records don't tie down valid IDs forever.
